allOf.description: A list of URIs representing departure places for this event. Each URI must reference a place in UiTdatabank. Only applicable when the event's `childrenOnly` flag is `true`. When not sent in a later update (or sent as `null`), the current departure places are kept; send an empty array to remove them. Explicitly sending `childrenOnly: false` in a `POST /events` or `PUT /events/{eventId}` body also removes all departure places. Setting it to `false` with `PUT /events/{eventId}/children-only` keeps them, so remove them first with `PUT /events/{eventId}/departure-places`.
